tools.name: SubagentHandback
tools.description:
Deliver your final report to the agent that spawned you (your caller). Use it once, for that hand-off only: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so do everything else first and put everything your caller needs in that one report. It is not a messaging channel: do not use it for progress updates or questions.

Only a report delivered through SubagentHandback reaches your caller; plain text you write at the end of your run is NOT delivered. There is no recipient parameter: the report can only go to your caller.

## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>

<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>

<?claude block s1?>

<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.

     7	from __future__ import annotations

     9	_active: set[str] = set()
    10	fired: list[str] = []
    11	
    12	
    13	def configure(specs: list[str]) -> None:

    15	    _active.update(specs)

    24	        _active.discard(spec)
    25	        fired.append(spec)

    28	        with neatlogs.trace(f"fault:injected:{spec}", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:

     1	"""Deterministic checks and the computed confidence score.
     2	
     3	confidence = checks × signals × freshness, each in [0, 1]:
     4	  checks    = passed / total checks attached to the finding's inputs
     5	  signals   = min(1, n_signals / 2) × agreement        (agreement = low/high of the signals; 1 if internal)
     6	  freshness = 1.0 if the oldest input is ≤ 90 days old, falling linearly to 0.5 at 365 days (floor 0.5)
     7	Nothing here is typed in by hand; every input comes from RunState.
     8	"""
     9	
    10	from __future__ import annotations
    11	
    12	from spendradar.models import Check
    13	
    14	TOLERANCE = 0.01  # line items must sum to the stated total within 1%
    15	
    16	
    17	def totals_check(target: str, parts: list[float], stated: float) -> Check:
    18	    s = sum(parts)
    19	    diff = abs(s - stated) / stated if stated else (0 if s == 0 else 1)
    20	    return Check(name="verify:totals", target=target, passed=diff <= TOLERANCE,
    21	                 detail=f"line items sum {s:,.2f} vs stated {stated:,.2f} ({diff:.2%} off)")
    22	
    23	
    24	def freshness(days: int) -> float:
    25	    if days <= 90:
    26	        return 1.0
    27	    return max(0.5, 1.0 - 0.5 * (days - 90) / (365 - 90))
    28	
    29	
    30	def confidence(checks_passed: int, checks_total: int, n_signals: int, agreement: float | None,
    31	               oldest_days: int) -> tuple[float, dict]:
    32	    c = checks_passed / checks_total if checks_total else 1.0
    33	    s = min(1.0, n_signals / 2) * (agreement if agreement is not None else (1.0 if n_signals == 0 else 0.5))
    34	    f = freshness(oldest_days)
    35	    inputs = {"checks": f"{checks_passed}/{checks_total}", "checks_score": round(c, 3), "n_signals": n_signals,
    36	              "agreement": None if agreement is None else round(agreement, 3), "signals_score": round(s, 3),
    37	              "oldest_input_days": oldest_days, "freshness_score": round(f, 3)}
    38	    return round(c * s * f, 3), inputs

   338	def _chain(role: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:

   345	def _cache_key(role: str, prompt: str, system: str | None, schema, tools, attachments=None) -> str:
   346	    att = [hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for b, _ in attachments or []]
   347	    blob = json.dumps([role, prompt, system, schema.__name__ if schema else None, tools, att], sort_keys=True)
   348	    return hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest()[:24]

   351	def _run_chain(role: str, prompt: str, system: str | None, schema: type[BaseModel] | None,
   352	               tools: list[dict] | None, attachments: list[tuple[bytes, str]] | None = None,
   353	               exclude: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> LLMResult:
   354	    key = _cache_key(role, prompt, system, schema, tools, attachments) + ("-x" + "-".join(exclude) if exclude else "")
   355	    key = hashlib.sha256(key.encode()).hexdigest()[:24] if exclude else key
   356	    path = CACHE_DIR / f"{key}.json"
   357	    if cache_enabled() and path.exists():
   358	        res = LLMResult(**json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
   359	        res.cached = True
   360	        return res
   361	
   362	    # Models the ledger already knows are out of quota, and text-only providers when a file is
   363	    # attached, are routed around up front; that is planned routing, not a fallback. A fallback
   364	    # is a hop after a call failed in *this* request.

   369	    for i, (provider, model) in enumerate(chain):

   371	            errors.append(f"{model}: daily quota exhausted (ledger)")
   372	            continue
   373	        if i > 0 and errors:
   374	            fallbacks.append(model)
   375	            with neatlogs.trace(f"fallback:{model}", kind="CHAIN") as span:
   376	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.fallback.to", model)
   377	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.fallback.provider", provider)
   378	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.fallback.reasons", json.dumps(errors[-3:]))

   380	                       output={"fallback_to": model, "provider": provider})

   393	                    break

   396	                    continue

   399	                if isinstance(e, NotFreeModelError):
   400	                    raise
   401	                errors.append(f"{model}: {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:120]}")
   402	                break

   405	                            tokens_out=tout, latency_s=round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2), fallbacks=fallbacks)

   407	                CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   408	                path.write_text(json.dumps(res.__dict__ | {"cached": False}, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
   409	            return res
   410	    raise LLMError(f"all models failed for role {role!r}: " + " | ".join(errors[-6:]))

   413	def complete(role: str, prompt: str, *, system: str | None = None, schema: type[T] | None = None,
   414	             attachments: list[tuple[bytes, str]] | None = None, exclude: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> LLMResult:
   415	    """Text or validated JSON. Malformed JSON is re-asked with the validation error.
   416	
   417	    `exclude` removes models from the chain (e.g. the model whose verdict a second opinion checks).
   418	    """
   419	    res = _run_chain(role, prompt, system, schema, None, attachments, exclude)
   420	    if schema is None:
   421	        return res
   422	    reasks, current, last_err = 0, res, None
   423	    while True:
   424	        try:
   425	            current.parsed = schema.model_validate_json(_strip_fences(current.text))
   426	            current.reasks = reasks
   427	            return current
   428	        except ValidationError as e:
   429	            last_err = e
   430	            if reasks >= CONFIG["json_reasks"]:
   431	                break
   432	            reasks += 1
   433	            with neatlogs.trace("recover:json_reask", kind="CHAIN") as span:
   434	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.reask.attempt", reasks)
   435	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.reask.error", str(e)[:1000])
   436	                fix = (f"{prompt}\n\nYour previous reply was not valid for the required JSON schema.\n"
   437	                       f"Validation error:\n{str(e)[:1500]}\n\nPrevious reply:\n{current.text[:3000]}\n\n"
   438	                       "Reply again with ONLY corrected JSON.")
   439	                # Same role: a re-ask must not quietly hand the decision to a weaker model.
   440	                current = _run_chain(role, fix, system, schema, None, attachments, exclude)
   441	    raise LLMError(f"JSON still invalid after {reasks} re-asks: {last_err}")

   444	def choose(role: str, prompt: str, options: list[dict], *, system: str | None = None) -> Choice:
   445	    """Native function calling: the model must call exactly one of `options`.
   446	
   447	    Each option is {"name", "description", "parameters": JSON schema}.
   448	    """
   449	    res = _run_chain(role, prompt, system, None, options)
   450	    names = {o["name"] for o in options}
   451	    if not res.parsed or res.parsed.get("name") not in names:
   452	        raise LLMError(f"model did not pick a valid option: {res.parsed!r} / {res.text[:200]!r}")
   453	    return Choice(name=res.parsed["name"], args=res.parsed.get("args", {}), result=res)

   456	def _strip_fences(text: str) -> str:
   457	    t = text.strip()
   458	    if t.startswith("```"):
   459	        t = t.split("\n", 1)[1] if "\n" in t else t
   460	        t = t.rsplit("```", 1)[0]
   461	    return t.strip()

     6	OpenRouter `:free` models. Every hop away from the first model is a

    79	class Ledger:
    80	    """Requests/tokens per model per day, persisted to cache/ledger.json."""
    81	
    82	    def __init__(self, path: Path = LEDGER_PATH):
    83	        self.path = path
    84	        self.lock = threading.Lock()
    85	        self.data: dict = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else {}
    86	        self.last_call: dict[str, float] = {}

    88	    def _day(self, model: str) -> dict:
    89	        today = self.data.setdefault(date.today().isoformat(), {})
    90	        return today.setdefault(model, {"requests": 0, "tokens_in": 0, "tokens_out": 0, "exhausted": False})
    91	
    92	    def limits(self, model: str) -> dict:
    93	        lim = CONFIG["limits"]
    94	        if model in lim:
    95	            return lim[model]
    96	        if model.endswith(":free"):
    97	            return lim["openrouter_free"]
    98	        return lim.get(model, lim["default_gemini"])

   100	    def remaining(self, model: str) -> int:
   101	        d = self._day(model)

   103	            return 0  # paid spend cap reached: route to free models
   104	        return 0 if d["exhausted"] else max(0, self.limits(model)["rpd"] - d["requests"])

   106	    def wait_turn(self, model: str) -> None:
   107	        gap = 60.0 / self.limits(model)["rpm"]
   108	        with self.lock:
   109	            wait = self.last_call.get(model, 0) + gap - time.monotonic()
   110	            self.last_call[model] = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, wait)
   111	        if wait > 0:
   112	            time.sleep(wait)

   115	        with self.lock:
   116	            d = self._day(model)
   117	            d["requests"] += 1
   118	            d["tokens_in"] += tokens_in
   119	            d["tokens_out"] += tokens_out
   120	            price = CONFIG.get("paid_prices", {}).get(model)
   121	            if price:  # paid model: track real dollars against the daily cap
   122	                d["usd"] = round(d.get("usd", 0.0) + tokens_in / 1e6 * price[0] + tokens_out / 1e6 * price[1], 6)

   149	def _normalise_path(input_dir: str, path: str) -> str:
   150	    """Planner paths must be relative to the input folder, with forward slashes. Models sometimes prefix the
   151	    folder, and once wrote Windows paths ("invoices\\\\08_x.pdf", run 1010-0cb70b) that leaked into the report."""
   152	    p = re.sub(r"[\\/]+", "/", path.strip())
   153	    p, root = p.lstrip("./"), re.sub(r"[\\/]+", "/", input_dir).rstrip("/").lstrip("./") + "/"
   154	    while p.startswith(root):
   155	        p = p[len(root):]
   156	    return p

   308	def job_window_start(days: int, today: date | None = None) -> str:
   309	    """Start of the job-posting window, anchored to this week's Monday so the request (and its cache key)
   310	    is identical all week. Anchoring to today changed the key daily: every first run of a new day paid
   311	    Crustdata again (14–18 credits per company on 11 Oct), against a plan that assumes weekly refreshes."""
   312	    today = today or date.today()
   313	    return (today - timedelta(days=today.weekday() + days)).isoformat()

   374	def _options_for(task: Task, failure: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
   375	    """Applicable recovery menu + what a fixed rule would do (the 'default')."""
   376	    if task.tool == "read_invoice" and failure.startswith("tool_error"):
   377	        # The rule default matters when no model is reachable: a file with no text layer is
   378	        # exactly what the LLM reader is for; anything else (e.g. corrupt) gets skipped.
   379	        return ["reparse_alt", "skip"], ("reparse_alt" if task.args.get("mode", "text") == "text" else "skip")
   380	    if task.tool == "read_invoice":
   381	        return ["reparse_alt", "mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
   382	    if task.tool == "read_budget":
   383	        return ["narrow_range", "mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
   384	    if task.tool == "fetch_competitor" and ("has_data" in failure or failure.startswith("tool_error")):
   385	        return ["substitute_competitor", "skip"], "skip"
   386	    if task.tool == "fetch_competitor" and "agreement" in failure:
   387	        # Disagreeing role vs function headcount: no extra source exists for it; flag it.
   388	        return ["mark_low_confidence"], "mark_low_confidence"
   389	    if task.tool in ("fetch_competitor", "classify_titles"):
   390	        # One weak category never justifies dropping a competitor's other categories.
   391	        extra_done = task.parent is not None and task.reason.startswith("recovery: re-estimate")
   392	        return (["mark_low_confidence"] if extra_done else ["fetch_more_signal", "mark_low_confidence"]), \
   393	            "mark_low_confidence"
   394	    if task.tool == "fetch_jobs":
   395	        return ["mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
   396	    return ["mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "skip"

   399	def decide_recovery(state: RunState, task: Task, failure: str, detail: str) -> str:
   400	    options, default = _options_for(task, failure)
   401	    if len(options) == 1:  # nothing to decide: no LLM call, no quota
   402	        state.decisions.append(RecoveryDecision(task_id=task.id, failed_check=f"{failure}: {detail}"[:300],
   403	                                                options=options, chosen=options[0], reason="only applicable action",
   404	                                                model="rule", default=default))
   405	        return options[0]
   406	    tools = [{"name": o, "description": RECOVERY[o], "parameters": {
   407	        "type": "object", "properties": {"reason": {"type": "string", "description": "one line"}},
   408	        "required": ["reason"]}} for o in options]
   409	    prompt = (f"A step of the finance agent failed verification.\nTask: {task.tool} {json.dumps(task.args)}\n"
   410	              f"Failure: {failure}\nDetail: {detail}\nAttempts so far: {task.attempts}\n"
   411	              f"Previous decisions for this task: "
   412	              f"{[d.chosen for d in state.decisions if d.task_id in (task.id, task.parent)]}\n"
   413	              "Pick the recovery action most likely to produce a correct, sourced number. "
   414	              "Do not repeat an action that already failed for this task.")
   415	    with neatlogs.trace("decide:recovery", kind="AGENT") as span:
   416	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.options", json.dumps(options))
   417	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.default", default)
   418	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.failure", f"{failure}: {detail}"[:500])
   419	        set_io(span, input={"task": task.id, "tool": task.tool, "failure": failure, "detail": detail[:500],
   420	                            "options": options, "default": default})
   421	        try:
   422	            choice = llm.choose("reason", prompt, tools,
   423	                                system="You choose recovery actions for a finance analysis agent.")
   424	            _usage(state, choice.result)
   425	            chosen, reason, model = choice.name, choice.args.get("reason", ""), choice.result.model
   426	        except llm.LLMError as e:
   427	            chosen, reason, model = default, f"LLM unavailable, rule default used: {str(e)[:120]}", "rule"
   428	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.chosen", chosen)
   429	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.reason", reason[:300])
   430	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.differs_from_default", chosen != default)
   431	        set_io(span, output={"chosen": chosen, "reason": reason[:300], "model": model,
   432	                             "differs_from_default": chosen != default})
   433	    state.decisions.append(RecoveryDecision(task_id=task.id, failed_check=f"{failure}: {detail}"[:300],
   434	                                            options=options, chosen=chosen, reason=reason, model=model,
   435	                                            default=default))
   436	    return chosen

94	    94	def _usage(state: RunState, res: llm.LLMResult | dict | None) -> None:
95	    95	    if not res:
96	    96	        return
97	    97	    d = res if isinstance(res, dict) else {"model": res.model, "tokens_in": res.tokens_in,
98	    98	                                           "tokens_out": res.tokens_out, "latency_s": res.latency_s,
99	    99	                                           "cached": res.cached, "fallbacks": res.fallbacks}
100	   100	    u = state.llm_usage.setdefault(d["model"], {"calls": 0, "cached_calls": 0, "tokens_in": 0, "tokens_out": 0,
101	   101	                                                "latency_s": 0.0, "fallback_hops": 0})
102	   102	    if d.get("cached"):  # served from the local cache: no tokens spent, no time waited
103	   103	        u["cached_calls"] += 1
104	   104	        return
105	   105	    u["calls"] += 1
106	   106	    u["tokens_in"] += d.get("tokens_in", 0)
107	   107	    u["tokens_out"] += d.get("tokens_out", 0)
108	   108	    u["latency_s"] = round(u["latency_s"] + d.get("latency_s", 0.0), 2)
109	   109	    u["fallback_hops"] += len(d.get("fallbacks") or [])

114	   114	def plan(state: RunState) -> None:
115	   115	    listing = files.list_files(state.input_dir)
116	   116	    comps = yaml.safe_load((Path(state.input_dir) / "competitors.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
117	   117	    prompt = (
118	   118	        f"GOAL: {state.goal}\n\nINPUT FOLDER ({state.input_dir}):\n"
119	   119	        + "\n".join(f"- {f['path']} ({f['bytes']} bytes)" for f in listing)
120	   120	        + "\n\nCOMPETITORS:\n" + "\n".join(f"- {c['name']} ({c['domain']})" for c in comps["competitors"])
121	   121	        + "\n\nTOOLS:\n" + "\n".join(f"- {k}: {v}" for k, v in TOOL_DOCS.items())
122	   122	        + "\n\nWrite the task list. Paths are relative to the input folder. Read every finance file once "
123	   123	          "(invoices default to mode 'text'; ignore README/competitors.yaml), fetch every competitor, fetch jobs "
124	   124	          "and classify titles for every competitor (needed for ML/AI), and order tasks so inputs exist before "
125	   125	          "they are needed. One task per file or competitor action.")
126	   126	    with neatlogs.trace("plan", kind="AGENT") as span:
127	   127	        res = llm.complete("reason", prompt, schema=Plan,
128	   128	                           system="You are the planner of a finance analysis agent. Be complete and concrete.")
129	   129	        _usage(state, res)
130	   130	        p: Plan = res.parsed
131	   131	        state.plan_rationale = p.rationale
132	   132	        # Competitor names come from competitors.yaml, keyed by domain. The planner once wrote its task text
133	   133	        # ("fetch Ramp data") into the name field, and that string reached the report (held-out run 1010-dd2fc1).
134	   134	        known = {c["domain"]: c["name"] for c in comps["competitors"] + comps.get("substitutes", [])}
135	   135	        for i, t in enumerate(p.tasks):
136	   136	            args = {k: v for k, v in t.model_dump().items() if k not in ("tool", "reason") and v is not None}
137	   137	            if "path" in args:
138	   138	                args["path"] = _normalise_path(state.input_dir, args["path"])
139	   139	            if args.get("domain") in known:
140	   140	                args["name"] = known[args["domain"]]
141	   141	            state.queue.append(Task(id=f"t{i + 1:02d}", tool=t.tool, args=args, reason=t.reason))
142	   142	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.plan.tasks", len(state.queue))
143	   143	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.plan.model", res.model)
144	   144	        _verify_plan(state, listing, comps)
145	   145	    state.phase = "execute"
146	   146	    save(state)

149	   149	def _normalise_path(input_dir: str, path: str) -> str:
150	   150	    """Planner paths must be relative to the input folder, with forward slashes. Models sometimes prefix the
151	   151	    folder, and once wrote Windows paths ("invoices\\\\08_x.pdf", run 1010-0cb70b) that leaked into the report."""
152	   152	    p = re.sub(r"[\\/]+", "/", path.strip())
153	   153	    p, root = p.lstrip("./"), re.sub(r"[\\/]+", "/", input_dir).rstrip("/").lstrip("./") + "/"
154	   154	    while p.startswith(root):
155	   155	        p = p[len(root):]
156	   156	    return p

160	   160	    """Coverage check: every invoice, the budget and every competitor must be in the plan."""
161	   161	    with neatlogs.trace("verify:plan_coverage", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
162	   162	        planned_paths = {t.args.get("path") for t in state.queue}
163	   163	        planned_domains = {(t.tool, t.args.get("domain")) for t in state.queue}
164	   164	        missing: list[Task] = []
165	   165	        for f in listing:
166	   166	            path = f["path"]
167	   167	            if path.startswith("invoices/") and path not in planned_paths:
168	   168	                missing.append(Task(id="", tool="read_invoice", args={"path": path, "mode": "text"},
169	   169	                                    reason="added by plan coverage check"))
170	   170	        for tool, fname in (("read_budget", "budget_fy27.xlsx"), ("read_policy", "policy.yaml"),
171	   171	                            ("read_salary_table", "salary_table.csv")):
172	   172	            if not any(t.tool == tool for t in state.queue):
173	   173	                missing.append(Task(id="", tool=tool, args={"path": fname}, reason="added by plan coverage check"))
174	   174	        for c in comps["competitors"]:
175	   175	            for tool in ("fetch_competitor", "fetch_jobs", "classify_titles"):
176	   176	                if (tool, c["domain"]) not in planned_domains:

178	   178	                                        reason="added by plan coverage check"))
179	   179	        for j, t in enumerate(missing):

181	   181	            state.queue.append(t)
182	   182	        state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:plan_coverage", target="plan", passed=not missing,
183	   183	                                  detail=f"{len(missing)} tasks added: " + ", ".join(
184	   184	                                      f"{t.tool}({t.args.get('path') or t.args.get('domain')})" for t in missing)))

309	   309	    """Start of the job-posting window, anchored to this week's Monday so the request (and its cache key)

374	   374	def _options_for(task: Task, failure: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
375	   375	    """Applicable recovery menu + what a fixed rule would do (the 'default')."""
376	   376	    if task.tool == "read_invoice" and failure.startswith("tool_error"):
377	   377	        # The rule default matters when no model is reachable: a file with no text layer is
378	   378	        # exactly what the LLM reader is for; anything else (e.g. corrupt) gets skipped.
379	   379	        return ["reparse_alt", "skip"], ("reparse_alt" if task.args.get("mode", "text") == "text" else "skip")
380	   380	    if task.tool == "read_invoice":
381	   381	        return ["reparse_alt", "mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
382	   382	    if task.tool == "read_budget":
383	   383	        return ["narrow_range", "mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
384	   384	    if task.tool == "fetch_competitor" and ("has_data" in failure or failure.startswith("tool_error")):
385	   385	        return ["substitute_competitor", "skip"], "skip"
386	   386	    if task.tool == "fetch_competitor" and "agreement" in failure:
387	   387	        # Disagreeing role vs function headcount: no extra source exists for it; flag it.
388	   388	        return ["mark_low_confidence"], "mark_low_confidence"

487	   487	def execute(state: RunState) -> None:
488	   488	    deferrals: dict[str, int] = {}
489	   489	    while state.queue:
490	   490	        task = state.queue.pop(0)
491	   491	        task.attempts += 1
492	   492	        if task.attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS:
493	   493	            task.status = "failed"
494	   494	            state.not_analysed.append({"input": task.args.get("path") or task.args.get("domain"),
495	   495	                                       "reason": f"retry cap ({MAX_ATTEMPTS}) reached"})
496	   496	            state.done.append(task)
497	   497	            save(state)
498	   498	            continue
499	   499	        try:
500	   500	            checks = act(state, task)
501	   501	            failure = None
502	   502	        except NotReady as e:
503	   503	            deferrals[task.id] = deferrals.get(task.id, 0) + 1
504	   504	            task.attempts -= 1
505	   505	            if deferrals[task.id] <= len(state.queue) + 1:
506	   506	                state.queue.append(task)
507	   507	                continue
508	   508	            checks, failure = [], f"tool_error: {e}"
509	   509	        except (ToolError, llm.LLMError) as e:
510	   510	            checks, failure = [], f"tool_error: {e}"
511	   511	        except Exception as e:  # never let one task kill the run; record it and recover
512	   512	            checks, failure = [], f"tool_error: unexpected {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"
513	   513	        state.checks.extend(checks)
514	   514	        bad = [c for c in checks if not c.passed]
515	   515	        if failure is None and bad:
516	   516	            failure = f"{bad[0].name} failed"
517	   517	        if failure:
518	   518	            detail = failure if failure.startswith("tool_error") else "; ".join(f"{c.target}: {c.detail}" for c in bad)
519	   519	            with neatlogs.trace(f"verify:{task.tool}", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
520	   520	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.passed", False)
521	   521	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.detail", detail[:500])
522	   522	                set_io(span, input={"task": task.id, "tool": task.tool, "args": task.args},
523	   523	                       output={"passed": False, "failure": failure[:300], "detail": detail[:500]})
524	   524	            if task.attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
525	   525	                chosen = "mark_low_confidence" if not failure.startswith("tool_error") else "skip"
526	   526	            else:
527	   527	                chosen = decide_recovery(state, task, failure.split(":")[0] if failure.startswith("tool_error") else failure,
528	   528	                                         detail)
529	   529	            apply_recovery(state, task, chosen, detail)
530	   530	            task.status = "failed"
531	   531	        else:
532	   532	            task.status = "done"
533	   533	        state.done.append(task)
534	   534	        save(state)
535	   535	    _cross_document_checks(state)
536	   536	    state.phase = "audit"
537	   537	    save(state)

556	   556	def _duplicate_check(state: RunState) -> None:
557	   557	    """Same vendor + same invoice number, or same vendor + date + amount, in two files → billed twice.
558	   558	    Added after the held-out eval: Kestrel and Ledgerly each had a re-sent invoice that no check caught."""
559	   559	    with neatlogs.trace("verify:duplicate_invoices", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
560	   560	        seen: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
561	   561	        dups = 0
562	   562	        for inv in sorted(state.invoices, key=lambda i: i["path"]):
563	   563	            v = inv["vendor"].strip().lower()
564	   564	            keys = [("number", v, inv["number"].strip())] if inv["number"].strip() else []
565	   565	            keys.append(("date+amount", v, inv["date"].strip(), round(inv["stated_total"], 2)))
566	   566	            first = next((seen[k] for k in keys if k in seen), None)
567	   567	            if first:
568	   568	                dups += 1
569	   569	                inv["duplicate_of"] = first["path"]
570	   570	                state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:duplicate_invoice", target=inv["path"], passed=False,
571	   571	                                          detail=f"same vendor and {'number' if first['number'] == inv['number'] else 'date and amount'} as {first['path']}"))
572	   572	                state.flags.append({"task": "cross-document", "target": inv["vendor"],
573	   573	                                    "issue": f"duplicate invoice {inv['number']}: {inv['path']} repeats {first['path']} "
574	   574	                                             f"(${inv['stated_total']:,.0f}); likely billed twice, counted once"})
575	   575	            for k in keys:
576	   576	                seen.setdefault(k, inv)
577	   577	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.duplicates", dups)

595	   595	def _line_item_check(state: RunState) -> None:
596	   596	    """One LLM call: which category does each invoice's WORK belong to? A mismatch with its cost centre is
597	   597	    flagged for the audit. Catches a mis-categorised invoice from a vendor that appears only once, which the
598	   598	    vendor-consistency rule cannot see (held-out company Carebridge). Python decides what counts as a mismatch."""
599	   599	    invs = [i for i in state.invoices if not i.get("duplicate_of") and i["category"] != "unmapped"]
600	   600	    if not invs:
601	   601	        return
602	   602	    flagged_vendors = {fl["target"] for fl in state.flags if "mis-categorised" in fl["issue"]}
603	   603	    prompt = ("For each invoice, say which budget category the WORK in its line items belongs to: "
604	   604	              "engineering, ml_ai, sales, marketing or infra_cloud ('unclear' if you cannot tell). Judge only from "
605	   605	              "the line items, not from the cost centre or vendor name.\n\n"
606	   606	              + "\n".join(f"- {i['number']} | vendor {i['vendor']} | lines: "
607	   607	                          + "; ".join(line["description"] for line in i["lines"]) for i in invs))

610	   610	            res = llm.complete("extract", prompt, schema=LineItemReview,
611	   611	                               system="You classify invoice line items into budget categories.")
612	   612	        except llm.LLMError as e:
613	   613	            state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:line_items", target="invoices", passed=True,
614	   614	                                      detail=f"not run: {str(e)[:80]}"))

616	   616	        _usage(state, res)
617	   617	        by_number = {j.invoice_number.strip(): j for j in res.parsed.invoices}
618	   618	        for inv in invs:
619	   619	            j = by_number.get(inv["number"].strip())
620	   620	            if not j or j.category_of_line_items in ("unclear", inv["category"]):

629	   629	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.line_item_mismatches",
630	   630	                           sum(c.name == "verify:line_items" and not c.passed for c in state.checks))

662	   662	        state.findings.append(Finding(

675	   675	def _gap_sentence(heads: tuple[float, float], usd: tuple[float, float], company: str = "Our company") -> str:
676	   676	    """Plain-language gap: positive heads = the company would need more people to match the median."""
677	   677	    lo, hi = sorted(heads)
678	   678	    ulo, uhi = sorted(usd)
679	   679	
680	   680	    def people(n: float) -> str:
681	   681	        return f"{abs(n):.0f} {'more' if n > 0 else 'fewer'}"
682	   682	
683	   683	    def money(x: float) -> str:
684	   684	        return f"${abs(x):,.0f} {'more' if x > 0 else 'less'}"
685	   685	
686	   686	    def span(a: str, b: str) -> str:
687	   687	        return a if a == b else f"{a} to {b}"
688	   688	
689	   689	    if lo >= 0 or hi <= 0:
690	   690	        return (f"Matching the competitor median would take {span(people(lo), people(hi))} people "
691	   691	                f"(≈ {span(money(ulo), money(uhi))} a year at {company}'s loaded cost; estimate).")
692	   692	    return (f"{company} is inside the competitor median range "
693	   693	            f"({people(lo)} to {people(hi)} people, ≈ {money(ulo)} to {money(uhi)} a year; estimate).")

    94	def _usage(state: RunState, res: llm.LLMResult | dict | None) -> None:
    95	    if not res:

    98	                                           "tokens_out": res.tokens_out, "latency_s": res.latency_s,
    99	                                           "cached": res.cached, "fallbacks": res.fallbacks}

   106	    u["tokens_in"] += d.get("tokens_in", 0)
   107	    u["tokens_out"] += d.get("tokens_out", 0)

   114	def plan(state: RunState) -> None:

   120	        + "\n\nCOMPETITORS:\n" + "\n".join(f"- {c['name']} ({c['domain']})" for c in comps["competitors"])
   121	        + "\n\nTOOLS:\n" + "\n".join(f"- {k}: {v}" for k, v in TOOL_DOCS.items())
   122	        + "\n\nWrite the task list. Paths are relative to the input folder. Read every finance file once "
   123	          "(invoices default to mode 'text'; ignore README/competitors.yaml), fetch every competitor, fetch jobs "
   124	          "and classify titles for every competitor (needed for ML/AI), and order tasks so inputs exist before "
   125	          "they are needed. One task per file or competitor action.")
   126	    with neatlogs.trace("plan", kind="AGENT") as span:
   127	        res = llm.complete("reason", prompt, schema=Plan,
   128	                           system="You are the planner of a finance analysis agent. Be complete and concrete.")
   129	        _usage(state, res)
   130	        p: Plan = res.parsed

   134	        known = {c["domain"]: c["name"] for c in comps["competitors"] + comps.get("substitutes", [])}
   135	        for i, t in enumerate(p.tasks):
   136	            args = {k: v for k, v in t.model_dump().items() if k not in ("tool", "reason") and v is not None}
   137	            if "path" in args:

   143	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.plan.model", res.model)
   144	        _verify_plan(state, listing, comps)

   149	def _normalise_path(input_dir: str, path: str) -> str:
   150	    """Planner paths must be relative to the input folder, with forward slashes. Models sometimes prefix the
   151	    folder, and once wrote Windows paths ("invoices\\\\08_x.pdf", run 1010-0cb70b) that leaked into the report."""
   152	    p = re.sub(r"[\\/]+", "/", path.strip())
   153	    p, root = p.lstrip("./"), re.sub(r"[\\/]+", "/", input_dir).rstrip("/").lstrip("./") + "/"
   154	    while p.startswith(root):
   155	        p = p[len(root):]
   156	    return p

   160	    """Coverage check: every invoice, the budget and every competitor must be in the plan."""
   161	    with neatlogs.trace("verify:plan_coverage", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
   162	        planned_paths = {t.args.get("path") for t in state.queue}
   163	        planned_domains = {(t.tool, t.args.get("domain")) for t in state.queue}

   178	                                        reason="added by plan coverage check"))

   180	            t.id = f"c{j + 1:02d}"
   181	            state.queue.append(t)
   182	        state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:plan_coverage", target="plan", passed=not missing,

   308	def job_window_start(days: int, today: date | None = None) -> str:
   309	    """Start of the job-posting window, anchored to this week's Monday so the request (and its cache key)
   310	    is identical all week. Anchoring to today changed the key daily: every first run of a new day paid
   311	    Crustdata again (14–18 credits per company on 11 Oct), against a plan that assumes weekly refreshes."""
   312	    today = today or date.today()
   313	    return (today - timedelta(days=today.weekday() + days)).isoformat()

   319	    res = crustdata.crustdata_jobs(domain, since=since, category=category, limit=60)
   320	    state.crustdata_credits = crustdata.BUDGET.spent
   321	    titles = [t["title"] for t in res["titles"] if t["title"]]
   322	    sm = state.title_classes.setdefault("_samples", {}).setdefault(domain, {})
   323	    sm[sample] = titles
   324	    sm[f"{sample}_fetched_at"] = res["fetched_at"]
   325	    sm[f"{sample}_query"] = f"since {since}" + (f", category={category}" if category else "")
   326	    return [Check(name="verify:has_data", target=f"jobs:{domain}", passed=len(titles) >= 5,

   335	    titles = sample.get("recent_titles_csv", []) + [t for k in JOB_SAMPLES for t in sample.get(k, [])]
   336	    known = {t: v for t, v in state.title_classes.items() if not t.startswith("_")}
   337	    todo = [t for t in set(titles) if t not in known]
   338	    if todo:

   340	        for u in usage:

   342	        state.title_classes.update(classes)

   355	    prof.signals = [s for s in prof.signals if s.category != "ml_ai"]

   369	    "mark_low_confidence": "Keep the data, flag it, and lower confidence in anything that uses it.",
   370	    "skip": "Drop this input and list it under 'Not analysed'.",
   371	}

   374	def _options_for(task: Task, failure: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
   375	    """Applicable recovery menu + what a fixed rule would do (the 'default')."""
   376	    if task.tool == "read_invoice" and failure.startswith("tool_error"):
   377	        # The rule default matters when no model is reachable: a file with no text layer is
   378	        # exactly what the LLM reader is for; anything else (e.g. corrupt) gets skipped.
   379	        return ["reparse_alt", "skip"], ("reparse_alt" if task.args.get("mode", "text") == "text" else "skip")
   380	    if task.tool == "read_invoice":
   381	        return ["reparse_alt", "mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
   382	    if task.tool == "read_budget":
   383	        return ["narrow_range", "mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
   384	    if task.tool == "fetch_competitor" and ("has_data" in failure or failure.startswith("tool_error")):
   385	        return ["substitute_competitor", "skip"], "skip"
   386	    if task.tool == "fetch_competitor" and "agreement" in failure:
   387	        # Disagreeing role vs function headcount: no extra source exists for it; flag it.
   388	        return ["mark_low_confidence"], "mark_low_confidence"
   389	    if task.tool in ("fetch_competitor", "classify_titles"):
   390	        # One weak category never justifies dropping a competitor's other categories.
   391	        extra_done = task.parent is not None and task.reason.startswith("recovery: re-estimate")
   392	        return (["mark_low_confidence"] if extra_done else ["fetch_more_signal", "mark_low_confidence"]), \
   393	            "mark_low_confidence"
   394	    if task.tool == "fetch_jobs":
   395	        return ["mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "mark_low_confidence"
   396	    return ["mark_low_confidence", "skip"], "skip"

   399	def decide_recovery(state: RunState, task: Task, failure: str, detail: str) -> str:
   400	    options, default = _options_for(task, failure)
   401	    if len(options) == 1:  # nothing to decide: no LLM call, no quota
   402	        state.decisions.append(RecoveryDecision(task_id=task.id, failed_check=f"{failure}: {detail}"[:300],
   403	                                                options=options, chosen=options[0], reason="only applicable action",
   404	                                                model="rule", default=default))
   405	        return options[0]
   406	    tools = [{"name": o, "description": RECOVERY[o], "parameters": {
   407	        "type": "object", "properties": {"reason": {"type": "string", "description": "one line"}},
   408	        "required": ["reason"]}} for o in options]
   409	    prompt = (f"A step of the finance agent failed verification.\nTask: {task.tool} {json.dumps(task.args)}\n"
   410	              f"Failure: {failure}\nDetail: {detail}\nAttempts so far: {task.attempts}\n"
   411	              f"Previous decisions for this task: "
   412	              f"{[d.chosen for d in state.decisions if d.task_id in (task.id, task.parent)]}\n"
   413	              "Pick the recovery action most likely to produce a correct, sourced number. "
   414	              "Do not repeat an action that already failed for this task.")
   415	    with neatlogs.trace("decide:recovery", kind="AGENT") as span:
   416	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.options", json.dumps(options))
   417	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.default", default)
   418	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.failure", f"{failure}: {detail}"[:500])
   419	        set_io(span, input={"task": task.id, "tool": task.tool, "failure": failure, "detail": detail[:500],
   420	                            "options": options, "default": default})
   421	        try:
   422	            choice = llm.choose("reason", prompt, tools,
   423	                                system="You choose recovery actions for a finance analysis agent.")
   424	            _usage(state, choice.result)
   425	            chosen, reason, model = choice.name, choice.args.get("reason", ""), choice.result.model
   426	        except llm.LLMError as e:
   427	            chosen, reason, model = default, f"LLM unavailable, rule default used: {str(e)[:120]}", "rule"
   428	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.chosen", chosen)
   429	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.reason", reason[:300])
   430	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.recovery.differs_from_default", chosen != default)
   431	        set_io(span, output={"chosen": chosen, "reason": reason[:300], "model": model,
   432	                             "differs_from_default": chosen != default})
   433	    state.decisions.append(RecoveryDecision(task_id=task.id, failed_check=f"{failure}: {detail}"[:300],
   434	                                            options=options, chosen=chosen, reason=reason, model=model,
   435	                                            default=default))
   436	    return chosen

   439	def apply_recovery(state: RunState, task: Task, chosen: str, detail: str) -> None:
   440	    a = task.args
   441	    fix = None
   442	    if chosen == "reparse_alt":
   443	        fix = Task(id=f"{task.id}r", tool=task.tool, args={**a, "mode": "llm" if a.get("mode", "text") == "text" else "text"},
   444	                   reason="recovery: reparse_alt", parent=task.id, attempts=task.attempts)
   445	    elif chosen == "narrow_range":
   446	        m = re.search(r"row (\d+)", detail)
   447	        row = int(m.group(1)) if m else None
   448	        fix = Task(id=f"{task.id}n", tool=task.tool, args={**a, "row": row}, reason="recovery: narrow_range",
   449	                   parent=task.id, attempts=task.attempts)
   450	    elif chosen == "fetch_more_signal":
   451	        dom = a.get("domain")
   452	        fix = Task(id=f"{task.id}m", tool="fetch_jobs", args={"domain": dom, "sample": "engineering_2y"},
   453	                   reason="recovery: fetch_more_signal (different sample: engineering postings, 2 years)",
   454	                   parent=task.id, attempts=task.attempts)
   455	        state.queue.insert(0, Task(id=f"{task.id}mc", tool="classify_titles", args={"domain": dom},
   456	                                   reason="recovery: re-estimate after extra signal", parent=task.id,
   457	                                   attempts=task.attempts))
   458	    elif chosen == "substitute_competitor":
   459	        _substitute(state, task)
   460	    elif chosen == "mark_low_confidence":
   461	        state.flags.append({"task": task.id, "target": a.get("path") or a.get("domain"), "issue": detail})
   462	    elif chosen == "skip":
   463	        state.not_analysed.append({"input": a.get("path") or a.get("domain"), "reason": detail})
   464	        if task.tool == "fetch_competitor":
   465	            state.competitors.pop(a.get("domain"), None)
   466	    if fix:
   467	        state.queue.insert(0, fix)

   470	def _substitute(state: RunState, task: Task) -> None:
   471	    comps = yaml.safe_load((Path(state.input_dir) / "competitors.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   472	    used = set(state.competitors) | {n["input"] for n in state.not_analysed}
   473	    sub = next((s for s in comps.get("substitutes", []) if s["domain"] not in used), None)
   474	    dropped = task.args.get("domain")
   475	    old = state.competitors.pop(dropped, None)
   476	    dropped_name = task.args.get("name") or (old.name if old else dropped)
   477	    state.not_analysed.append({"input": dropped, "reason": "replaced by substitute competitor"})
   478	    if sub:
   479	        state.notes.append(f"{dropped_name} replaced by {sub['name']} (substitute list order)")
   480	        for i, tool in enumerate(("fetch_competitor", "fetch_jobs", "classify_titles")):
   481	            state.queue.insert(i, Task(id=f"{task.id}s{i}", tool=tool, args={"name": sub["name"], "domain": sub["domain"]},
   482	                                       reason=f"recovery: substitute for {dropped_name}", parent=task.id))

   487	def execute(state: RunState) -> None:
   488	    deferrals: dict[str, int] = {}
   489	    while state.queue:
   490	        task = state.queue.pop(0)
   491	        task.attempts += 1
   492	        if task.attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS:
   493	            task.status = "failed"
   494	            state.not_analysed.append({"input": task.args.get("path") or task.args.get("domain"),
   495	                                       "reason": f"retry cap ({MAX_ATTEMPTS}) reached"})
   496	            state.done.append(task)
   497	            save(state)
   498	            continue
   499	        try:
   500	            checks = act(state, task)
   501	            failure = None
   502	        except NotReady as e:
   503	            deferrals[task.id] = deferrals.get(task.id, 0) + 1
   504	            task.attempts -= 1
   505	            if deferrals[task.id] <= len(state.queue) + 1:
   506	                state.queue.append(task)
   507	                continue
   508	            checks, failure = [], f"tool_error: {e}"
   509	        except (ToolError, llm.LLMError) as e:
   510	            checks, failure = [], f"tool_error: {e}"
   511	        except Exception as e:  # never let one task kill the run; record it and recover
   512	            checks, failure = [], f"tool_error: unexpected {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"
   513	        state.checks.extend(checks)
   514	        bad = [c for c in checks if not c.passed]
   515	        if failure is None and bad:
   516	            failure = f"{bad[0].name} failed"
   517	        if failure:
   518	            detail = failure if failure.startswith("tool_error") else "; ".join(f"{c.target}: {c.detail}" for c in bad)
   519	            with neatlogs.trace(f"verify:{task.tool}", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
   520	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.passed", False)
   521	                span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.detail", detail[:500])
   522	                set_io(span, input={"task": task.id, "tool": task.tool, "args": task.args},
   523	                       output={"passed": False, "failure": failure[:300], "detail": detail[:500]})
   524	            if task.attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
   525	                chosen = "mark_low_confidence" if not failure.startswith("tool_error") else "skip"
   526	            else:
   527	                chosen = decide_recovery(state, task, failure.split(":")[0] if failure.startswith("tool_error") else failure,
   528	                                         detail)
   529	            apply_recovery(state, task, chosen, detail)
   530	            task.status = "failed"
   531	        else:
   532	            task.status = "done"
   533	        state.done.append(task)
   534	        save(state)
   535	    _cross_document_checks(state)
   536	    state.phase = "audit"
   537	    save(state)

   556	def _duplicate_check(state: RunState) -> None:
   557	    """Same vendor + same invoice number, or same vendor + date + amount, in two files → billed twice.
   558	    Added after the held-out eval: Kestrel and Ledgerly each had a re-sent invoice that no check caught."""
   559	    with neatlogs.trace("verify:duplicate_invoices", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
   560	        seen: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
   561	        dups = 0
   562	        for inv in sorted(state.invoices, key=lambda i: i["path"]):
   563	            v = inv["vendor"].strip().lower()
   564	            keys = [("number", v, inv["number"].strip())] if inv["number"].strip() else []
   565	            keys.append(("date+amount", v, inv["date"].strip(), round(inv["stated_total"], 2)))
   566	            first = next((seen[k] for k in keys if k in seen), None)
   567	            if first:
   568	                dups += 1
   569	                inv["duplicate_of"] = first["path"]
   570	                state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:duplicate_invoice", target=inv["path"], passed=False,
   571	                                          detail=f"same vendor and {'number' if first['number'] == inv['number'] else 'date and amount'} as {first['path']}"))
   572	                state.flags.append({"task": "cross-document", "target": inv["vendor"],
   573	                                    "issue": f"duplicate invoice {inv['number']}: {inv['path']} repeats {first['path']} "
   574	                                             f"(${inv['stated_total']:,.0f}); likely billed twice, counted once"})
   575	            for k in keys:
   576	                seen.setdefault(k, inv)
   577	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.duplicates", dups)

   580	def _vendor_category_check(state: RunState) -> None:
   581	    """Same vendor billed to different categories → flag (catches mis-categorised invoices)."""
   582	    with neatlogs.trace("verify:vendor_category_consistency", kind="GUARDRAIL"):
   583	        by_vendor: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
   584	        for inv in state.invoices:
   585	            by_vendor.setdefault(inv["vendor"], set()).add(inv["category"])
   586	        for vendor, cats in by_vendor.items():
   587	            ok = len(cats) == 1
   588	            state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:vendor_category", target=vendor, passed=ok,
   589	                                      detail=f"categories {sorted(cats)}"))
   590	            if not ok:
   591	                state.flags.append({"task": "cross-document", "target": vendor,
   592	                                    "issue": f"vendor billed to {sorted(cats)}; likely mis-categorised invoice"})

   595	def _line_item_check(state: RunState) -> None:
   596	    """One LLM call: which category does each invoice's WORK belong to? A mismatch with its cost centre is
   597	    flagged for the audit. Catches a mis-categorised invoice from a vendor that appears only once, which the
   598	    vendor-consistency rule cannot see (held-out company Carebridge). Python decides what counts as a mismatch."""
   599	    invs = [i for i in state.invoices if not i.get("duplicate_of") and i["category"] != "unmapped"]
   600	    if not invs:
   601	        return
   602	    flagged_vendors = {fl["target"] for fl in state.flags if "mis-categorised" in fl["issue"]}
   603	    prompt = ("For each invoice, say which budget category the WORK in its line items belongs to: "
   604	              "engineering, ml_ai, sales, marketing or infra_cloud ('unclear' if you cannot tell). Judge only from "
   605	              "the line items, not from the cost centre or vendor name.\n\n"
   606	              + "\n".join(f"- {i['number']} | vendor {i['vendor']} | lines: "
   607	                          + "; ".join(line["description"] for line in i["lines"]) for i in invs))
   608	    with neatlogs.trace("verify:line_items_vs_cost_centre", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
   609	        try:
   610	            res = llm.complete("extract", prompt, schema=LineItemReview,
   611	                               system="You classify invoice line items into budget categories.")
   612	        except llm.LLMError as e:
   613	            state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:line_items", target="invoices", passed=True,
   614	                                      detail=f"not run: {str(e)[:80]}"))
   615	            return
   616	        _usage(state, res)
   617	        by_number = {j.invoice_number.strip(): j for j in res.parsed.invoices}
   618	        for inv in invs:
   619	            j = by_number.get(inv["number"].strip())
   620	            if not j or j.category_of_line_items in ("unclear", inv["category"]):
   621	                continue
   622	            state.checks.append(Check(name="verify:line_items", target=inv["path"], passed=False,
   623	                                      detail=f"cost centre → {inv['category']}, line items → {j.category_of_line_items}"))
   624	            if inv["vendor"] not in flagged_vendors:
   625	                flagged_vendors.add(inv["vendor"])
   626	                state.flags.append({"task": "cross-document", "target": inv["vendor"],
   627	                                    "issue": f"{inv['number']} billed to {inv['category']} but its line items look like "
   628	                                             f"{j.category_of_line_items} ({j.reason[:120]}); likely mis-categorised invoice"})
   629	        span.set_attribute("spendradar.verify.line_item_mismatches",
   630	                           sum(c.name == "verify:line_items" and not c.passed for c in state.checks))

   635	def build_findings(state: RunState) -> None:
   636	    ours_all = analysis.our_position(state.budget)
   637	    profiles = list(state.competitors.values())
   638	    rules = {r["category"]: r for r in state.policy.get("rules", [])}
   639	    state.findings = []
   640	    for cat in ("engineering", "ml_ai", "sales", "marketing"):
   641	        rule = rules.get(cat)
   642	        shares = analysis.competitor_shares(profiles, cat)
   643	        if not rule or cat not in ours_all:
   644	            continue
   645	        res = analysis.compare({**ours_all[cat], "_total": ours_all["_total"]}, shares, rule, state.salary.get(cat, 0))
   646	        if res["status"] != "ok":
   647	            state.notes.append(f"{cat}: no competitor data for comparison")
   648	            continue
   649	        n_sig = [s["signals"] for s in shares]
   650	        agreements = [a for p in profiles if (a := analysis.signal_agreement(p, cat)) is not None]
   651	        ages = [analysis.days_old(s.as_of) for p in profiles for s in p.signals if s.category == cat]
   652	        rel = [c for c in state.checks if c.target.endswith(f":{cat}") or c.target == f"budget:{cat}"]
   653	        conf, inputs = verify.confidence(sum(c.passed for c in rel), len(rel), min(n_sig),
   654	                                         min(agreements) if agreements else None, max(ages) if ages else 0)
   655	        fid = f"f_{cat}"
   656	        state.figures[f"{fid}_median"] = Figure(
   657	            id=f"{fid}_median", label=f"Competitor median {cat} share of headcount", unit="share",
   658	            value=res["median_mid"], category=cat, estimate=True,
   659	            sources=[s.source for p in profiles for s in p.signals if s.category == cat])
   660	        g0, g1 = res["gap_usd"]
   661	        verdict = "violates" if res["violated"] else "meets"
   662	        state.findings.append(Finding(
   663	            id=fid, category=cat, kind="policy",
   664	            statement=(f"{state.company} {cat} is {res['our_share']:.1%} of headcount vs competitor median "
   665	                       f"{res['median_low']:.1%}–{res['median_high']:.1%} ({res['n_competitors']} companies); "
   666	                       f"{verdict} policy '{rule['text']}'. "
   667	                       f"{_gap_sentence(res['gap_heads'], (g0, g1), state.company)}"),
   668	            ours=ours_all[cat]["share"], theirs_low=res["median_low"], theirs_high=res["median_high"],
   669	            policy_violated=res["violated"], figure_ids=[f"hc_{cat}", f"cost_{cat}", f"{fid}_median"],
   670	            confidence=conf, confidence_inputs=inputs))
   671	    _internal_findings(state)
   672	    save(state)

   675	def _gap_sentence(heads: tuple[float, float], usd: tuple[float, float], company: str = "Our company") -> str:
   676	    """Plain-language gap: positive heads = the company would need more people to match the median."""
   677	    lo, hi = sorted(heads)
   678	    ulo, uhi = sorted(usd)
   679	
   680	    def people(n: float) -> str:
   681	        return f"{abs(n):.0f} {'more' if n > 0 else 'fewer'}"
   682	
   683	    def money(x: float) -> str:
   684	        return f"${abs(x):,.0f} {'more' if x > 0 else 'less'}"
   685	
   686	    def span(a: str, b: str) -> str:
   687	        return a if a == b else f"{a} to {b}"
   688	
   689	    if lo >= 0 or hi <= 0:
   690	        return (f"Matching the competitor median would take {span(people(lo), people(hi))} people "
   691	                f"(≈ {span(money(ulo), money(uhi))} a year at {company}'s loaded cost; estimate).")
   692	    return (f"{company} is inside the competitor median range "
   693	            f"({people(lo)} to {people(hi)} people, ≈ {money(ulo)} to {money(uhi)} a year; estimate).")
   694

   696	def _internal_findings(state: RunState) -> None:
   697	    seen: set[str] = set()
   698	    for c in state.checks:
   699	        if c.name == "verify:totals" and not c.passed and c.target not in seen:
   700	            seen.add(c.target)
   701	            state.findings.append(Finding(id=f"f_totals_{len(state.findings)}", category="internal", kind="internal",
   702	                                          statement=f"Totals mismatch in {c.target}: {c.detail}. Line items used.",
   703	                                          confidence=1.0, confidence_inputs={"checks": "deterministic"}))
   704	    for fl in state.flags:
   705	        if "mis-categorised" in fl["issue"]:
   706	            state.findings.append(Finding(id=f"f_cat_{len(state.findings)}", category="internal", kind="internal",
   707	                                          statement=f"{fl['target']}: {fl['issue']}.", confidence=0.0,
   708	                                          confidence_inputs={"checks": "needs audit"}))
   709	        elif fl["issue"].startswith("duplicate invoice"):
   710	            state.findings.append(Finding(id=f"f_dup_{len(state.findings)}", category="internal", kind="internal",
   711	                                          statement=f"{fl['target']}: {fl['issue']}.", confidence=1.0,
   712	                                          confidence_inputs={"checks": "deterministic (vendor + number/date/amount)"}))
   713	    infra = [i for i in state.invoices if i["category"] == "infra_cloud" and not i.get("duplicate_of")]
   714	    monthly = state.budget.get("monthly", {}).get("infra_cloud")
   715	    rule = next((r for r in state.policy.get("rules", []) if r["category"] == "infra_cloud"), None)
   716	    if infra and monthly and rule:
   717	        over = [i for i in infra if i["line_sum"] > monthly * (1 + rule["pct"] / 100)]
   718	        state.findings.append(Finding(
   719	            id="f_infra_cloud", category="infra_cloud", kind="internal",
   720	            statement=(f"{len(over)} of {len(infra)} infra/cloud invoices exceed the monthly budget "
   721	                       f"${monthly:,.0f} by more than {rule['pct']}%"
   722	                       + (": " + ", ".join(f"{i['number']} ${i['line_sum']:,.0f}" for i in over) if over else "") + "."),
   723	            policy_violated=bool(over), figure_ids=["inv_" + Path(i["path"]).stem for i in infra],
   724	            confidence=1.0, confidence_inputs={"checks": "deterministic, internal data"}))

   729	def run_phases(state: RunState) -> RunState:
   730	    with neatlogs.trace("spendradar_run", kind="WORKFLOW", session_id=state.run_id) as root:
   731	        tid = format(root.get_span_context().trace_id, "032x")
   732	        state.trace_id = state.trace_id or tid
   733	        state.trace_ids.append(tid)
   734	        root.set_attribute("spendradar.run_id", state.run_id)
   735	        root.set_attribute("spendradar.resumed_at_phase", state.phase)
   736	        if state.phase == "plan":
   737	            plan(state)
   738	        if state.phase == "execute":
   739	            execute(state)
   740	        if state.phase == "audit":
   741	            build_findings(state)
   742	            audit.self_audit(state)
   743	            state.phase = "report"
   744	            save(state)
   745	        if state.phase == "report":

"""LLM title classifier: job title → spend category (ml_ai has no Crustdata role)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

import neatlogs
from pydantic import BaseModel

from spendradar import llm

SYSTEM = (
    "You map job titles to spend categories for a people-cost comparison.\n"
    "engineering: software, infra, SRE, security, data engineering, developer advocacy.\n"
    "ml_ai: roles whose main job is building or researching ML/AI models or ML/AI products "
    "(ML engineer, applied scientist, AI engineer, research scientist, MLOps).\n"
    "sales: AE, SDR/BDR, sales engineering, solutions/pre-sales, partnerships, customer success.\n"
    "marketing: product/growth/brand/content marketing, events, comms.\n"
    "other: everything else (product management, design, finance, HR, ops, support, legal, interns "
    "that do not clearly fit). Classify by the role's work, not by buzzwords in the team name."
)


class TitleLabel(BaseModel):
    title: str
    category: Literal["engineering", "ml_ai", "sales", "marketing", "other"]


class TitleBatch(BaseModel):
    labels: list[TitleLabel]


@neatlogs.span(kind="TOOL", name="act:classify_titles", tool_name="classify_titles")
def classify_titles(titles: list[str], batch: int = 40) -> tuple[dict[str, dict], list[dict]]:
    """Returns ({title: {category, model}}, [llm usage per call])."""
    uniq = sorted({t for t in titles if t})
    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    usage = []
    for i in range(0, len(uniq), batch):
        chunk = uniq[i:i + batch]
        prompt = "Classify each title. Return every title exactly as given.\n" + "\n".join(f"- {t}" for t in chunk)
        res = llm.complete("extract", prompt, system=SYSTEM, schema=TitleBatch)
        usage.append({"model": res.model, "tokens_in": res.tokens_in, "tokens_out": res.tokens_out,
                      "latency_s": res.latency_s, "cached": res.cached, "reasks": res.reasks,
                      "fallbacks": res.fallbacks})
        # Models echo titles trimmed; match on the stripped form and key by the original title,
        # or titles with stray whitespace (common in Crustdata) are silently dropped.
        by_stripped = {t.strip(): t for t in chunk}
        for lab in res.parsed.labels:
            orig = by_stripped.get(lab.title.strip())
            if orig is not None:
                out[orig] = {"category": lab.category, "model": res.model}
    return out, usage

      openrouter: [google/gemma-4-31b-it:free, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free]

      gemini: [gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.6-flash]
      openrouter: [google/gemma-4-31b-it:free]
    extract:  # PDF extraction, title classification, JSON re-asks
      openai: [gpt-5-nano]   # text only; PDF attachments fall through to Gemini
      gemini: [gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-flash-lite-latest, gemma-4-31b-it]
      openrouter: [google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free]
    second_opinion:  # independent audit check, different model from the verdict it checks
      openai: [gpt-5-nano]
      gemini: [gemini-3.5-flash-lite]
      openrouter: [nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free, google/gemma-4-31b-it:free]

  # Free-tier limits read from Google AI Studio → Rate Limit, 2026-10-10 16:27 IST (screenshot).
  # Daily exhaustion is also learned live from 429 quotaId=*PerDay* responses.
  limits:
    gemini-2.5-flash: {rpm: 5, rpd: 20}
    gemini-3.6-flash: {rpm: 5, rpd: 20}
    gemini-3.7-flash: {rpm: 5, rpd: 20}
    gemini-3.8-flash: {rpm: 5, rpd: 20}
    gemini-3.5-flash-lite: {rpm: 15, rpd: 500}
    gemini-3.1-flash-lite: {rpm: 15, rpd: 500}
    gemma-4-31b-it: {rpm: 30, rpd: 14400}   # TPM only 16K

  # Hackathon-provided OpenAI credits (not Akarsh's billing): every call is still costed (cfo.ai needs the

  gemini_timeout_s: 40         # per-call bound; added after run 1010-6f37e8 averaged 143 s/call

    "sales: AE, SDR/BDR, sales engineering, solutions/pre-sales, partnerships, customer success.\n"
    "marketing: product/growth/brand/content marketing, events, comms.\n"
    "other: everything else (product management, design, finance, HR, ops, support, legal, interns "
    "that do not clearly fit). Classify by the role's work, not by buzzwords in the team name."
)


class TitleLabel(BaseModel):
    title: str
    category: Literal["engineering", "ml_ai", "sales", "marketing", "other"]


class TitleBatch(BaseModel):
    labels: list[TitleLabel]


@neatlogs.span(kind="TOOL", name="act:classify_titles", tool_name="classify_titles")
def classify_titles(titles: list[str], batch: int = 40) -> tuple[dict[str, dict], list[dict]]:
    """Returns ({title: {category, model}}, [llm usage per call])."""
    uniq = sorted({t for t in titles if t})
    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    usage = []
    for i in range(0, len(uniq), batch):
        chunk = uniq[i:i + batch]
        prompt = "Classify each title. Return every title exactly as given.\n" + "\n".join(f"- {t}" for t in chunk)
        res = llm.complete("extract", prompt, system=SYSTEM, schema=TitleBatch)
        usage.append({"model": res.model, "tokens_in": res.tokens_in, "tokens_out": res.tokens_out,
                      "latency_s": res.latency_s, "cached": res.cached, "reasks": res.reasks,
                      "fallbacks": res.fallbacks})
        # Models echo titles trimmed; match on the stripped form and key by the original title,
        # or titles with stray whitespace (common in Crustdata) are silently dropped.
        by_stripped = {t.strip(): t for t in chunk}
        for lab in res.parsed.labels:
            orig = by_stripped.get(lab.title.strip())
            if orig is not None:
                out[orig] = {"category": lab.category, "model": res.model}
    return out, usage

def _recent_negative_news(state: RunState) -> list[dict]:
    hits = []
    for p in state.competitors.values():
        for n in p.news:
            title = (n.get("title") or "").lower()
            try:
                age = (date.today() - datetime.fromisoformat(n["date"][:10]).date()).days
            except Exception:
                continue
            if age <= NEWS_WINDOW_DAYS and any(w in title for w in NEWS_WORDS):
                hits.append({"company": p.name, **n})
    return hits


def _recompute_ok(state: RunState, f: Finding) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    if f.kind != "policy":
        return True, "internal finding: deterministic"
    rule = next((r for r in state.policy.get("rules", []) if r["category"] == f.category), None)
    ours = analysis.our_position(state.budget)
    res = analysis.compare({**ours[f.category], "_total": ours["_total"]},
                           analysis.competitor_shares(list(state.competitors.values()), f.category),
                           rule, state.salary.get(f.category, 0))
    ok = (res.get("status") == "ok" and abs(res["median_low"] - (f.theirs_low or 0)) < 1e-9
          and abs(res["median_high"] - (f.theirs_high or 0)) < 1e-9 and res["violated"] == f.policy_violated)
    return ok, "recomputed and matched" if ok else f"recompute mismatch: {res}"


def _sources_ok(state: RunState, f: Finding) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    missing = [fid for fid in f.figure_ids if fid not in state.figures or not state.figures[fid].sources]
    return not missing, "all figures sourced" if not missing else f"unsourced figures: {missing}"


def _evidence_against(state: RunState, f: Finding, news: list[dict]) -> list[str]:
    ev = []
    if f.kind == "policy":
        for p in state.competitors.values():
            r = analysis.category_range(p, f.category)
            if not r:
                continue
            sigs = [s for s in p.signals if s.category == f.category]
            ag = analysis.signal_agreement(p, f.category)
            if ag is not None and ag < 0.6:
                ev.append(f"{p.name} {f.category} signals disagree: " + "; ".join(
                    f"{s.name}={s.headcount:.0f} (as of {s.as_of})" for s in sigs))
        for n in news:
            ev.append(f"news {n['date']} {n['company']}: {n['title']} ({n['url']})")
    if "mis-categorised" in f.statement:
        vendor = f.statement.split(":")[0]
        line_checks = {c.target: c.detail for c in state.checks if c.name == "verify:line_items" and not c.passed}
        for inv in state.invoices:
            if inv["vendor"] == vendor:
                ev.append(f"{inv['number']} cost centre '{inv['cost_centre']}' → {inv['category']}; lines: "
                          + "; ".join(line['description'] for line in inv["lines"]))
                # The agent's own line-item check already judged this invoice; the auditor must weigh that
                # result rather than re-judge from scratch (run 1011-4f1f02 overturned a correct flag).
                if inv.get("path") in line_checks:
                    ev.append(f"{inv['number']} line-item check: {line_checks[inv['path']]}")
    return ev


def _judge(role: str, f: Finding, evidence: list[str], checks: list[str],
           exclude: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> tuple[Verdict, llm.LLMResult]:
    prompt = (f"FINDING ({f.category}, confidence {f.confidence}):\n{f.statement}\n\n"
              f"DETERMINISTIC CHECKS:\n" + "\n".join(f"- {c}" for c in checks)
              + "\n\nEVIDENCE THAT MIGHT CONTRADICT IT:\n" + ("\n".join(f"- {e}" for e in evidence) or "- none found")
              + "\n\nTry to disprove the finding. 'overturn' = the evidence shows it is wrong or unsupported; "
                "'downgrade' = it may hold but the evidence weakens it materially; 'confirm' = it survives. "
                "For an invoice flagged as mis-categorised, decide from the LINE ITEMS: does the work belong to the "
                "category of the cost centre it was billed to? The kind of work decides the category, not which "
                "cost centre paid. If any invoice's line items do not match its cost centre, the flag is correct: "
                "'confirm' and set corrected_category to the category the line items belong to. "
                "Judge only from the evidence given; do not invent facts.")
    res = llm.complete(role, prompt, schema=Verdict, exclude=exclude,
                       system="You are a sceptical finance auditor checking an analyst's findings.")
    return res.parsed, res


def self_audit(state: RunState) -> None:
    news = _recent_negative_news(state)
    second_left = llm.CONFIG["second_opinion_max_per_run"]
    for f in state.findings:
        with neatlogs.trace(f"audit:{f.id}", kind="AGENT") as span:
            rc_ok, rc = _recompute_ok(state, f)
            src_ok, src = _sources_ok(state, f)
            evidence = _evidence_against(state, f, news)
            checks = [rc, src]
            span.set_attribute("spendradar.audit.evidence", json.dumps(evidence)[:2000])
            set_io(span, input={"finding": f.id, "statement": f.statement, "evidence_against": evidence})
            if not rc_ok or not src_ok:
                f.status, f.audit_notes = "overturned", [rc, src]
                span.set_attribute("spendradar.audit.verdict", "overturned (deterministic)")
                set_io(span, output={"status": f.status, "how": "deterministic", "notes": f.audit_notes})
                continue
            if not evidence and f.kind == "internal" and "mis-categorised" not in f.statement:
                f.status = "confirmed"
                f.audit_notes.append("deterministic internal finding; no contradicting evidence")
                span.set_attribute("spendradar.audit.verdict", "confirmed (deterministic)")
                set_io(span, output={"status": f.status, "how": "deterministic", "notes": f.audit_notes})
                continue
            try:
                v, res = _judge("reason", f, evidence, checks)
                _usage_add(state, res)
            except llm.LLMError as e:
                f.status = "downgraded"
                f.audit_notes.append(f"audit LLM unavailable ({str(e)[:80]}); downgraded to be safe")
                set_io(span, output={"status": f.status, "how": "llm unavailable", "notes": f.audit_notes})
                continue
            f.audit_notes.append(f"{res.model}: {v.verdict} — {v.reason}")
            final = v.verdict
            if v.verdict != "confirm" and second_left > 0:
                second_left -= 1
                try:
                    # Independent means a different model from the verdict being checked.
                    v2, res2 = _judge("second_opinion", f, evidence, checks, exclude=(res.model,))
                    _usage_add(state, res2)
                    f.audit_notes.append(f"second opinion {res2.model}: {v2.verdict} — {v2.reason}")
                    span.set_attribute("spendradar.audit.second_opinion", v2.verdict)
                    if v2.verdict == "confirm" and v.verdict == "overturn":
                        final = "downgrade"  # disagreement between providers → soften, never silently confirm
                except llm.LLMError as e:
                    f.audit_notes.append(f"second opinion unavailable: {str(e)[:80]}")
            f.status = {"confirm": "confirmed", "downgrade": "downgraded", "overturn": "overturned"}[final]
            if final != "confirm":
                f.confidence = round(f.confidence * (0.5 if final == "downgrade" else 0.0), 3)
            if "mis-categorised" in f.statement and v.corrected_category != "none":
                f.audit_notes.append(f"corrected category: {v.corrected_category}")
                f.status = "confirmed"  # the flag itself is confirmed; the correction is applied in the report
                f.confidence = 1.0 if v.verdict != "overturn" else f.confidence
            span.set_attribute("spendradar.audit.verdict", f.status)
            set_io(span, output={"status": f.status, "how": "llm", "confidence": f.confidence, "notes": f.audit_notes})


def _usage_add(state: RunState, res: llm.LLMResult) -> None:
    from spendradar.agent import _usage

    _usage(state, res)
